Name: Ginger Island Leafy Dialogue UI Frame
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=2]I absolutely love the original [/size][url=http://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10274527]Yellog Flower Dialogue UI[/url][size=2] mod but I had some minor issuse with it recently - when you go on Ginger Island, the dialogue UI frame will still depend on the season (summer, spring, fall or winter), so it was kinda strange to see, for example, winter festive UI frame when I talked with NPCs on  Ginger Island. So I decided to make this "fix" of sort.[/size]


[b][u][color=#ff7700][size=3]How to use this mod:
[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[size=2]Since  [/size][url=http://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10274527]Yellog Flower Dialogue UI[/url]  doesn't have any conditions in it's content.json, both mine and it's UI frames would overlap each other (even when I added false dependency in manifest.json, it still happens), so to fix that I had to also add a whole UI dialogue box to hide Yellog's behind it (only when player is locaten on GIngeg Island).

There's 2 config options for this box to match other interface recolors: Vanilla and Vintage Interface V2.By default you'll have only VintageInterfaceV2 colored dialogue UI box -  I won't add any more other interface compability, but you can do it yourself! For that you'll need to do [u][b][color=#ff7700]those steps:[/color][/b][/u]

[list=1]
[*]Go to [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Ginger Island Leafy Dialogue UI Frame\assets [/b]folder

[*]Find [u][b]CursorsVI2.png[/b][/u] file in there and open it with any image editor

[*]Change the hue/saturation/brightnes of the frame as you desire
[*]After doing all the changes simply save the file and now "[u][b]VintageInterfaceV2[/b][/u]" option ingame will apply the recolor you made yourself
[/list]
[color=#ff7700][size=3][b][u]Credits:[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=2]Big thanks to [/size][size=2]Anette for allowing me to use their [/size][size=2][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage Mod[/url] assets![/size]
[*][size=2]Also thanks to ManaKirel for allowing to use their [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface V2[/url]  assets![/size]
[/list][center]
